subject.title: fix(agents): stop runs at the critical tool-loop threshold

question: Should `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.loopDetectionPreToolUseRelay: false` remain a narrow PreToolUse-only opt-out while the new PostToolUse loop-outcome relay stays enabled, or should it disable the paired loop-detection relay path?
rationale: The setting already exists and controls subprocess fan-out; the final branch, documentation, and PR body describe incompatible user-facing semantics, so automation cannot choose the compatibility contract safely.

options.title: Preserve the narrow PreToolUse contract
options.body: Keep PostToolUse enabled under false, update the PR body and reference docs to say so, and prove the final head with that configuration.

options.title: Make false disable both loop relays
options.body: Treat false as the complete loop-detection relay opt-out, revise the relay construction and focused tests, and preserve required policy and middleware relays.

recommendation.title: Preserve the narrow PreToolUse contract
recommendation.body: Keep PostToolUse enabled under false, update the PR body and reference docs to say so, and prove the final head with that configuration.
